name: CoinMarketCap
label: CoinMarketCap
description: CoinMarketCap official API via OfficialApiNode (api_spec.json). Operations: listings_latest, quotes_latest, info, global_metrics. Docs: https://coinmarketcap.com/api/documentation/guides/quick-start. CMC Professional API terms. Header X-CMC_PRO_API_KEY. Logo/data attribution required. Quick-start still documents GET /v1/cryptocurrency/listings/latest; reference also lists v3 listings/quotes. Secrets stay in configurationParameters. jobType custom-script-executor.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One CoinMarketCap request. Set operation plus the fields that operation requires. Delivered as inputVariables.input. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"listings_latest"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official HTTP operation to run. EXACT values: listings_latest | quotes_latest | info | global_metrics. Default: first listed or instance operation. Example: 'listings_latest'.

schema.label: convert
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `convert` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: limit
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `limit` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: start
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `start` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: symbol
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `symbol` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: {status:'ok', http_status, data}. Secrets never echoed. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body (or raw text if not JSON). Never includes the API secret.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is omitted. EXACT: listings_latest, quotes_latest, info, global_metrics.

configurationParameters.label: Api Key
configurationParameters.description: Provider secret. OfficialApiNode auth type `header`. Bind a StudioQuack secret. Never log, never put on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout seconds. Default 25. Keep under the daemon sandbox request budget.
